hero.headline: Structuring, Staffing, and Scaling High-Performance Businesses in Nigeria
hero.sub: From setting up investor-ready startups to managing outsourced teams and corporate retreats, Traction Outsourcing Limited builds the operational frameworks your business needs to thrive.

services.title: Startup Structuring & Governance
services.text: Build your business on a rock-solid foundation. We guide you through compliant CAC registration, co-founder equity agreements, IP protection, and governance frameworks that appeal to investors.

services.title: Operations & Corporate Restructuring
services.text: Stop operational chaos. We analyze your workflows, eliminate redundancies, and design clear organograms so every team member knows exactly who they report to and what they own.

services.title: Business Advisory
services.text: Strategic planning, feasibility studies, and negotiation support for entrepreneurs navigating growth, market entry, and critical structural decisions.

services.title: Corporate and Professional Trainings
services.text: We design and deliver targeted training programmes that close skill gaps, shift workplace culture, and build the internal capacity your business needs to operate without constant senior-level intervention.

services.title: Corporate Retreats & Events
services.text: High-end international retreats combining executive strategy sessions with premier travel. Our next retreat: T-ICR 2026 in Kigali, Rwanda, November 22-30.

services.title: Vetted Staff Outsourcing & Payroll
services.text: Outsource your recruitment, onboarding, and payroll to local experts. We manage statutory compliance including ITF, NSITF, and PenCom so you can scale without the legal liabilities.

why_us.title: Why Businesses Come to Us
why_us.sub: Three pain points bring most of our clients in. If any of these sounds familiar, you are in the right place.

points.title: Stuck in the Day-to-Day?
points.text: If your business cannot run without your constant physical presence, your operational structure is broken. We design custom organograms and workflows that give you your time back.

points.title: Struggling to Find and Keep Top Talent?
points.text: Hiring the wrong person costs millions in lost time and revenue. We handle the heavy lifting of recruitment, background checks, and payroll compliance.

points.title: Unprepared for Scaling or Funding?
points.text: Poor corporate governance or messy regulatory setups will stop you from winning major contracts or raising capital. We secure your legal foundations before the opportunity arrives.

entries.a: Traction Outsourcing Limited is a management consulting and HR solutions firm based in Abuja, Nigeria, serving clients across all major industries throughout Africa. Services include talent acquisition, HR process outsourcing, learning and development, startup structuring, corporate restructuring, business strategy consulting, and corporate retreats. ATH Recruiters, the recruitment arm of the firm, connects businesses with vetted, qualified talent across sectors.

entries.q: Where is Traction Outsourcing located in Abuja?
entries.a: Traction Outsourcing Limited is based at 26, Algiers Street, Wuse Zone 5, FCT, Abuja.

entries.q: Is Traction Outsourcing a management consulting firm in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing operates as a management consulting and business advisory firm serving companies across Nigeria, with a particular focus on staffing, HR, structuring, and governance work for growing businesses and SMEs.

entries.q: How do I get started with Traction Outsourcing?
entries.a: Book a free 30-minute clarity call through the button on this page, or reach out on WhatsApp or by phone. A member of the team will help determine which service fits your business before any engagement begins.
